issues.title: RR-101: Reconcile baseline and official template contract
issues.description:
## Agreed contract

Implement only this issue's scope in the existing Astro static site. The accepted redesign uses official Bootstrap 5.3.8 Dashboard/Sidebar examples (verified release date August 2025, not a 2026 release), with the Record sidebar as the only navigation. Marketing header and footer are removed only within `/record/`. Preserve ordinary website branding, URLs, five existing JSON contracts, AVIF media policy, and unrelated dirty working-tree changes. No framework upgrade, live analytics, authenticated backend, or production publication is included.

Operational BI uses approved public aggregate snapshots; never invent funding, outcomes, people, partnerships, traffic, or validation evidence. Missing is not zero. Full contract: `plan/record-room-bootstrap-bi.md`; umbrella: https://git.developerdojo.org/INSTARLab/Website/-/work_items/8.

## Agent handoff requirements

Read repository instructions and the build-astro-magazine skill in focused mode. Inspect current files before editing; older plan/checkpoint passes are historical. Work only within the ownership below. Request changes from shared owners rather than editing their files concurrently. Report changed files, commands/results, screenshots or artifacts, remaining risks, and exact next action. No nested agents unless the primary requests them.

## Ownership

**Owner:** Primary / explorer

Plan and studio baseline records only; no application edits.

## Work

Inventory all 12 Record HTML routes and five static JSON endpoints. Preserve the existing local candidate as the baseline, including untracked Record source. Record official template links, Bootstrap pin and MIT attribution, source/retrieval dates, page signatures, and the new authorized shell contract. Compare dashboard-first, evidence-led, and portfolio-led compositions within Bootstrap; select evidence-led with operational summaries. Diagnose CSS cascade and missing computed spacing in the current production render before carrying styles forward.

## Acceptance

- [ ] All 12 routes and five endpoints have a route/ownership ledger; existing working-tree changes are preserved.
- [ ] Desktop 1440px and mobile 390px baseline captures cover every Record route; protected marketing home/navigation/footer baselines are recorded.
- [ ] Record-local replacement explicitly supersedes the old requirement to retain SiteLayout; outside Record the current shell is protected.
- [ ] Baseline checks and current source/build identity are recorded; prior screenshots and passes are not treated as current acceptance.

## Dependencies

None.
